# Long Thin Part

Length of the whole part compared with its width: long thin parts warp.

<figure markdown="span">
![Long Thin Part: on the left what to avoid, on the right what to aim for](../../assets/diagrams/max-part-aspect-ratio-light.svg#only-light){ width="640" }
![Long Thin Part: on the left what to avoid, on the right what to aim for](../../assets/diagrams/max-part-aspect-ratio-dark.svg#only-dark){ width="640" }
<figcaption>Length of the whole part compared with its width.</figcaption>
</figure>

## Where it applies

| Process | Criticality |
| :-- | :-- |
| [Powder Bed Fusion (SLS)](../../reference/processes/powder-bed-fusion.md) | Low |

## Values

**Aim for** is what to design for; crossing it gives a warning. See [aim for and limits](../../concepts/aim-for-and-limits.md).

Criticality in this process: **Low** ([what this means](../../concepts/criticality.md)).

| Material | Aim for | Source |
| :-- | :-- | :-- |
| **Default** | 10× its width | Published, [HP](../../citations/bibliography.md#hp-mjf "Avoid parts over 10 times longer than wide") |

Every other material uses the Default values: PA12 (SLS), PA12 (MJF), PA11, PA12 Carbon-filled, TPU.

## Messages

What the results panel says about a finding. You can rewrite these in the Process Library; the words in `{braces}` are filled in for each finding.

!!! warning "Warning"

    Long thin part (`{measured}` its width): the part is `{size}`, more than `{target}` as long as it is wide. Long thin parts warp as they cool in the powder. Thicken, brace or split it; tilting it about 20° in the build also helps.
| Placeholder | Replaced with |
| :-- | :-- |
| `{measured}` | The measured value, with its unit |
| `{target}` | The rule's "Aim for" value |
| `{feature}` | What it is about, such as "Boss 3 (screw)" or "Face12" |
| `{size}` | Its size or what was found, such as "Ø3.00 mm and 9.00 mm deep" |
